key_insight: Humidity reshapes FAPbI₃ phase-transition pathways through competing water uptake by a layered metastable intermediate and the photo-inactive δ phase.
engineering_relevance: Understanding moisture-dependent transitions could guide humidity control during perovskite film fabrication and protection of the photoactive α phase during service.
method: Analysis of the Burgers pathway and competing water uptake
evidence_signal: Simulations reproduce the experimentally observed increase in the δ-to-α transition temperature with humidity and reveal a water-affine metastable intermediate.
watch_item: The abstract reports no device-level efficiency or lifetime validation, so practical processing and protection strategies require further testing.
paper_title: Humidity-modulated Ostwald Step Rule in $\rm FAPbI_3$ Martensitic Transitions
